mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_cert_review (worker_id, cert_code, exam_record_id, status, created_at) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{certCode}, #{examRecordId}, 'PENDING', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id AS workerId, cert_code AS certCode, exam_record_id AS examRecordId, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM t_cert_review WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_cert_review SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_note = #{note}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
